propositions: The _no_repo_commits autouse guard invokes git rev-parse HEAD before and after every test, projecting ~75s macOS wall-time overhead at full suite scale (~13,255 tests).
A 895-test A-B-B-A experiment measured 9.3% median wall-time savings when the guard was bypassed, but removing it violates per-test HEAD attribution and session fidelity constraints.

No consensus-approved implementation exists: adding a Git library (Dulwich/pygit2/GitPython) expands install/dependency risk; hand-parsing symbolic/loose/packed/linked-worktree refs carries correctness risk; removing the per-test guard weakens test-isolation coverage.
Four major OSS projects (pytest, pip, Poetry, pre-commit) do not run source-checkout VCS subprocesses in per-test hot paths, supporting the elimination direction but not any specific implementation.
